mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 63 degrees at Verona City Hall, with an air quality index of 54, which is in the moderate range.

The City is running an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to create designs for the November election, with submissions closing on July 22 and public voting scheduled from July 28 through August 7. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes before winter to ensure they meet U.S. Postal Service guidelines to avoid damage from snow plows.
We have a busy lineup today with the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the police report from July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had their vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in an arrest for an O-W-I.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM today; if you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be OREO Cookie Overload.
